pages.title: Tesseract Lens
pages.text: A lens that focuses light through the fourth dimension, letting it reach places ordinary light cannot. Used in lithography, it engraves circuits into hidden faces. It looks like a clear cube that seems slightly larger inside than out.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Tesseract Assembler I combined a Tesseract Core with a Dark Matter Lens, a Photonic Lens and Exotic Matter. Light passing through followed the fourth dimension before focusing.
Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic String Lens, Hyperdimensional Processor.
